finding.summary: The selected Global J-Space producer and bootstrap dataset compiler had diverged after the Vector Control ABI gained basis-byte identity and current packet parsing/validation. The producer trace did not export the exact canonical packet text consumed by the compiler, while the compiler still referenced superseded packet methods and fields.

unusual_experiment.result: Prototype trace, Vector Control ABI, and compiler were compared as one three-boundary contract. The mismatch localized to trace transport/export and stale compiler consumption rather than a second architecture or state-authority defect.
